title: Why every LUMINA product comes in black glass
excerpt: Light breaks down active ingredients. Here is what black glass does about it, and why it costs more.
author: LUMINA Studio

cover.alt: LUMINA products on dark water under a starry sky

body.text: Sample article. Replace this text with your own. Clear and frosted bottles look soft on a shelf, but they let light reach the formula every time the bottle is out.
What light does to a formula
Many active ingredients are sensitive to ultraviolet and visible light. Over weeks of use, that exposure can change colour, scent and how well a product works.
The last pump should be as good as the first.
Black glass is heavier to ship and harder to make. We think the trade is worth it.
